creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Comments often link other HN items. Leave the writer's link as
written and inject a small "Amber" pill after it: the raw link still
opens news.ycombinator.com in a new tab, the pill opens the thread in
Amber in the same tab. When the target is a comment in the thread you
are already reading, the pill jumps there in place instead of loading
anything.
title: open linked HN items in Amber
